errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the pie chart sectors are not arranged in descending order. In fact, if read counter-clockwise starting from the largest blue sector, the slices are arranged in descending order of their percentage values: 43.1%, 35.0%, 21.5%, 0.2%, 0.2%.
